prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake and optimized pre/post-workout nutrition timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
Includes pre-workout and post-workout nutrition strategically timed around training
Emphasizes high carbohydrate content appropriate for endurance athlete (approximately 8-10g carbs per kg body weight)
Plan is compact and concise (suitable for quick reference)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an elite endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific pre/post-workout nutrition timing

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and increase strength for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day with protein at each meal (minimum 30g per meal)
Pre- and post-training meals are strategically timed to support performance and recovery
Total daily calories create a moderate surplus appropriate for muscle building (approximately 500+ calorie surplus)
Plan is presented in compact, easy-to-follow format with clear meal times and portion sizes
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution, caloric surplus, and meal timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize performance and recovery for a soccer match with moderate-to-high intensity training session

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals plus pre/post-training snacks with appropriate timing
Includes hydration strategy with specific fluid recommendations
Provides quick energy options suitable for soccer training demands
Respects vegetarian and nut-free restrictions throughout all meals
